metadata.title: SpaceX IPO: Record-breaking deal prices at $135. The stock begins trading on Friday. - MarketWatch

content.text:
LIVE
SpaceX IPO: Record-breaking deal prices at $135. The stock begins trading on Friday.
The SpaceX IPO is getting closer, with official pricing coming in at $135 before trading begins on Friday. The deal for Elon Musk's space-technology company has shattered records and could usher in volatile trading, experts say.
Last Updated:
June 11, 2026 at 6:56 PM ET
Key Events
Latest Updates
Alphabet's Google is shaping up to be a major beneficiary of the SpaceX IPO. Google made a $1 billion investment in SpaceX alongside Fidelity in 2015. At the time, the 10% ownership stake was estimated to be worth $10 billion.
Google now has a 6.11% stake in SpaceX, according to a report filed filed with Alaska’s Commerce Department in April. At SpaceX's $1.77 trillion valuation, Google's stake is now worth $108 billion.
Beyond the investment windfall, Google is actively fueling SpaceX's compute business as a customer. Earlier this week Google signed a multi-year agreement to pay SpaceX $920 million per month from October 2026 through June 2029, a deal that includes access to 110,000 Nvidia GPUs and other AI hardware.
